answer: Problem: cheap clones flood challenge panels. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 0.35 POA onyx bond into a dune escrow, then must grow an orchard of 4 reciprocal attests from prior finalizers over 2 epochs before panel eligibility. Cost: 0.35 POA locked + ~48h wait. Verify: escrow height and attest graph logged on-ledger. Fail: bond burns if graph has >30% shared parents or clone clusters detected.
